name: Ikenai Koukyuu Yuugi ~Koutei Heika to Keiyaku no Hanayome~
original_name: イケない後宮遊戯 ～皇帝陛下と契約の花嫁～
source:
While you were arranging the books in the library, you accidentally fell into an unknown world! The great emperor of that world then suggested that you become the Princess consort for him?!

‘I’ll help you to go back to your original world. In exchange, you will be my princess consort.’

The arrogant emperor forcibly made you sign the marriage contract! And there are 8 different types of 'hot guys♡’ ready to help you?! In the end, will you go back to your original world? Or…

Now, the destined love story will begin.
translation:
你在圖書館整理書籍時，意外掉進了未知世界！這個世界的偉大皇帝提議讓你成為他的皇妃！？

「我會幫助你回到原本的世界。作為交換，你要成為我的皇妃。」

傲慢的皇帝強迫你簽下婚姻契約！還有八種不同類型的「帥哥♡」準備幫助你！？最終，你會回到原本的世界嗎？還是……

命中注定的戀愛故事，就此開始。
